Description: Students can see routes and timings through a simple interface.
Students can see live bus location and ETA on a map.
Admin manages routes/timings; testing, feedback and bug fixing.

As a student, I want to view all bus routes, so that I can choose the right bus for my destination.

Acceptance Criteria:
- System displays the list of routes
- Selecting a route shows its stops on the map

As a student, I want to check bus timings, so that I can plan when to leave for the bus stop.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Daily departure times shown per route
- Next upcoming bus is highlighted

As a student, I want a simple login and navigation, so that I can reach features easily.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Login works for student/driver/admin roles
- Wrong password shows an error

As a student, I want to see the current bus location, so that I know exactly where my bus is.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Bus marker moves on the map in real time
- 'Last updated' time is shown
- Outdated location (>30 s) is clearly marked

As a student, I want to see the estimated arrival time, so that I don't have to wait unnecessarily.

Acceptance Criteria:
- ETA (minutes) shown for every upcoming stop
- Passed stops are marked 'Passed'

Summary: US5 - Admin modifies routes and timings
Description:
As a transport admin, I want to modify routes and timings, so that I can respond to schedule changes.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Only admin can add/edit/delete routes and stops
- Changes appear to students immediately
- Student change requests can be approved/rejected
